verifications.claim: March Madness 2026 can be watched on TV via CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV from March 17 to April 6.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'March Madness features 67 games televised across four channels: CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.'; R2: 'The tournament opens with First Four qualifier games on March 17... National Championship on April 6.'; R10: 'March 17 - April 6 on TBS, CBS, TNT, & truTV'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly confirm the channels and date range for games starting March 17 (First Four) to April 6 (Championship).

verifications.claim: Final Four games are available on TBS, truTV, and via streaming on Max.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'FINAL FOUR... Sat. April 4... TBS'; R8: 'TV channel: TBS/TNT/truTV'; R12: 'HBO Max will stream... Final Four (including the championship) games (the live games... from TBS, TNT, and truTV)'
verifications.reasoning: References confirm Final Four on TBS (and simulcast on truTV/TNT), and Max streams TBS/TNT/truTV games including Final Four.

verifications.claim: The 67 games are split across CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'March Madness features 67 games televised across four channels: CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.'

verifications.claim: NCAA March Madness Live is the official app to stream all games.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'With NCAA March Madness Live, you can watch every game of the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship Live from almost any device!'
verifications.reasoning: R6 directly states it allows watching every game; R9 refers to MML as the app.

verifications.claim: NCAA March Madness Live may require a TV provider login for extended viewing.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R9: 'Following the 1 hour free preview, you will be prompted on your device to log in with your TV provider to continue watching'; 'Each user receives 60 minutes of Free Preview per day... before needing to enter their login credentials.'
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation of login requirement after limited free preview.

verifications.claim: Paramount+ streams games broadcast on CBS including the Championship with the Premium plan.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R6: 'Subscribe and Watch all CBS games in the Paramount+ app'; R3/R4/R7: Championship on 'TBS' (or 'TBS, TNT, TruTV')
verifications.reasoning: Paramount+ confirmed for CBS games, but Championship is explicitly on TBS (not CBS) in multiple refs.

verifications.claim: Max streams games that air on TBS, TNT, and truTV.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R12: 'HBO Max will stream a selection of 2026 March Madness® games... from TBS, TNT, and truTV'; R6: 'stream all TBS, TNT & TruTV games on HBO Max'
verifications.reasoning: Direct confirmation that Max (HBO Max) streams TBS, TNT, truTV games.

verifications.claim: YouTube TV carries CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R10: 'Catch all of the action March 17 - April 6 on TBS, CBS, TNT, & truTV'; 'YouTube TV lets you stream live... including CBS... TNT'
verifications.reasoning: YouTube TV page directly lists all four channels for March Madness.

verifications.claim: Hulu + Live TV carries CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Hulu + Live TV (three-day free trial) — CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV'; R5: 'Live game coverage... on CBS... TNT, TBS, and TruTV' on Hulu + Live TV
verifications.reasoning: Direct listing in R2 and Hulu page confirms coverage.

verifications.claim: DirecTV carries CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'DirectTV (five-day free trial) — CBS, TBS, TNT, and truTV'; R3/R8: Streaming on DirecTV for tournament games

verifications.claim: Sling TV offers packages for TBS, TNT, and truTV in Sling Orange/Blue.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: R7: 'Watch NCAA tournament action on Sling... stream via SlingTV'; R8: 'live TV services like Sling... Every game... on TBS, TNT, or truTV will stream on... Sling'; 'Sling Orange'
verifications.reasoning: Refs confirm Sling carries TBS/TNT/truTV games, mentions Orange, but no explicit package details for all three.
